purpose: Prospective confirmation of native CaDynamics_E2 -> SK_E2 ordering after the v1 reference assumed old cai and was contradicted by the native trace.
parent_diagnosis: IV-B1 48/48 passed; in IV-B2 the native gate used causally updated cai within each dt. The old-cai reference failed even though Ca dynamics and current algebra were accurate. The v1 run is retained, not retroactively promoted.
causal_discrete_order: Compute cai[t+1] from cai[t] and imposed ica[t], then compute SK z[t+1] from cai[t+1] and z[t]. Updated cai is a current-step causal intermediate, not a teacher future observation.
negative_control: A zero-calcium-current arm must remain near its no-injection trajectory. Every pulse arm must differ from rest by >1e-5mM peak cai and >1e-3 peak SK gate, including the two new independent schedules.
decision: IV-B1 and IV-B2 are separately judged on the unchanged v1 numerical thresholds. The v2 run must include 72 B1 and 12 B2 episodes with fresh late_single/triplet schedules. If both pass with informative perturbation and native current/clamp checks, Task32 electrical feedback may be prepared, not claimed complete. If either fails, do not close feedback.
scope: One compartment, imposed ionic ica, native CaDynamics_E2 and SK_E2, imposed V for B2. No autonomous voltage, morphology, synapses, axial coupling, variable calcium reversal or speed claim.
